name: The Dryad's Review
summary: A nameless dryad judges everything the party shows it. Its reviews grow warmer the more honest the party is.

stages.journal: A corrupted dryad asked to be shown things worth reviewing. It is hard to please.
stages.hint: Show it a few things: a weapon, a ration, the seed jar, the sketch.

stages.journal: The dryad gave its verdict on us.
